_schema_note: V4 gate (task spec): a citation may enter the paper only after it is verified by fetching its source page and recording url, title, first author, year into verified-citations.json. arxiv_id/doi are the machine-checkable tokens citation_check.py matches against paper text; verified_via records how/when the fetch was done. Release-gate repair (v0.5 P0, bibliography quality): entry_type/authors/venue fields (journal, volume, number, pages, booktitle) were added by re-fetching each source's own record (DOI via Crossref/DataCite, or the arXiv/publisher page for entries with no DOI) -- never typed by hand -- and are enforced by run_gates.py's G9 gate; first_author is kept in sync with authors[0] for backward compatibility with citation_check.py's schema check. entry_type is one of article/inproceedings/incollection/misc; misc is used for arXiv preprints (no formal venue yet), datasets, and standards/webpages where no DOI-backed venue exists, per G9's own "@misc only when unverifiable" rule.
